features.covered_by: PLAN CHK-001 adds GET /v1/runners/{runnerId}/jobs/stream after runner heartbeat and before existing signed claim; verification asserts stream GET precedes claim and SSE alone does not set claimedJobId.
PLAN CHK-001/CHK-002 require timeout, disconnect, empty snapshot, malformed/non-SSE, HTTP failure, and old-server paths to fall back to existing signed claim without hanging.
PLAN CHK-002 requires same customer API key source for protected reads and redacted diagnostics proving Authorization, Bearer, and raw customer key are omitted.
PLAN CHK-002 requires claim envelope to keep using options.runnerProvider and avoid provider-specific shortcuts; existing runner claim path uses options.runnerProvider.

PLAN CHK-003 updates docs/guide.md, lattice-authority-live-integration.md, and orchestrate-retirement.md to document SSE as optional hint/fallback and proofbound as canonical active root with Orchestrate retired read-only.

features.excluded_by: Story consumes the server B-24aa /jobs/stream contract from CLI only; checklist files modify only CLI client/runner/smoke and docs, not Python/server implementation.
PLAN explicitly says jobs.available is only a notification hint and must not be treated as lease, receipt, authorityDone, fullAuthorityDone, productionDone, or receipt verification.
PLAN CHK-003 only documents canonical proofbound and retired Orchestrate read-only status; no Orchestrate paths are in modify/create/test scope.
